about.title: About Me
about.description: I'm Afonso Lima, a final year Informatics and Computing Engineering student at the Faculty of Engineering of the University of Porto. Right now my focus is on backend, infrastructure and self hosting: I run my own services on Linux and Docker on a home server, and that's where most of my free time goes. I also contribute to student groups at FEUP, where I help build their websites and deploy and manage a Kubernetes cluster. Before that I built HabitWar, a social competition app that's still live on iOS and Android, and worked on web and mobile projects with React, React Native, Swift, TypeScript and PostgreSQL. I also write C, C++, Java and Python. Outside the digital world, I'm a two time national boxing champion, an important part of my background and identity.
